description: Header file defining the RendererVk class for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE, including class interfaces, Vulkan resource management, and related functions.

classes.name: RendererVk
classes.description: Class managing Vulkan renderer state, resources, and operations within ANGLE.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Vulkan renderer with display and extension info.

methods.name: isDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device is lost.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Gets maximum supported OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: getMaxConformantESVersion
methods.description: Gets maximum conformant OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: selectPresentQueueForSurface
methods.description: Selects a present queue for a surface.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves format info by internal format or FormatID.

methods.name: getDescriptorSetLayout
methods.description: Gets or creates descriptor set layout.

methods.name: issueShaderSerial
methods.description: Issues a new serial for shader modules.

methods.name: hasLinearImageFormatFeatureBits
methods.description: Checks format feature bits for images.

methods.name: queueSubmit
methods.description: Submits a command to the queue.

methods.name: queueWaitIdle
methods.description: Waits for queue to become idle.

methods.name: queuePresent
methods.description: Presents an image to the surface.

methods.name: collectGarbageAndReinit
methods.description: Collects garbage and reinitializes resource use.

methods.name: onNewGraphicsPipeline
methods.description: Marks pipeline cache as dirty on new pipeline.
